people.note: Founder of the Free Patriotic Movement (14 July 1994, established while in exile in Paris; he returned to Lebanon on 7 May 2005). President of Lebanon 31 October 2016 - 31 October 2022 (Wikipedia list; the Wikipedia article on the presidency says he served until 30 October 2022, and Wikidata gives 30 October 2022). Commander of the Lebanese Armed Forces 1984-1989 and disputed head of a military government 1988-1990 (Wikidata). Birth date conflict: the Wikipedia infobox gives 18 February 1935, Wikidata 30 September 1933; the Wikipedia date is used. The sub-ideology is a gameplay classification.

people.note: Prime Minister of Lebanon 31 October 1992 - 4 December 1998 and 26 October 2000 - 26 October 2004 (Wikipedia list; Wikidata gives 23 October 2000 - 21 October 2004 for the second term). Led the 'Hariri Bloc' (25 members of the 1996 parliament, all independents); the Future Movement, officially founded in 2007, is its successor. Died 14 February 2005 (Wikipedia and Wikidata). The sub-ideology is a gameplay classification.

people.note: Leader of the Future Movement since 20 April 2005 (Wikipedia infobox). Prime Minister of Lebanon 9 November 2009 - 13 June 2011 and 18 December 2016 - 21 January 2020 (Wikipedia list; the infobox gives the end of the second term as 21 January 2020). Member of Parliament 28 June 2005 - 21 May 2022. Announced the suspension of his political role on 24 January 2022 and the return of the Future Movement on 14 February 2025 (Wikipedia: Future Movement). The sub-ideology is a gameplay classification.

Independent. Prime Minister of Lebanon 15 February 2014 - 18 December 2016. Member of the March 14 Alliance until 2016 (Wikipedia infobox). Wikidata also lists him under the office of President of Lebanon for 25 May 2014 - 31 October 2016, the period in which the presidency was vacant. The sub-ideology is a gameplay classification.
